baseline.method: Independently executed author BiNI, author-provided quantized analytic normal fields; no actual depth truth

metric_provenance: Numerical agreement budget fixed before local extraction; independent original repeats checked separately. Additive gauge fixed to zero mean in each full support; no evaluator realignment.
definition: Both normal fields must attain the standard frozen-weight fixed-point quality and weighted residual energy, rather than its height array. Each sigmoid is evaluated from the submitted normal-scaled one-sided gaps. Zero gauge/outside support required. Stationarity tolerance is max(1e-6,1.1 times independently attained standard stationarity), energy no greater than standard times(1+1e-8).
